description: This file defines the DeflateStream class, which extends the Stream class, to manage deflate compression filters within a ZIP streaming context. It includes methods to add or remove deflate filters and to rewind the stream, handling the filtering process accordingly.

classes.name: DeflateStream
classes.description: Class for managing deflate compression stream filters within ZIP streams, with methods to add, remove, and rewind streams.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream, removing and re-adding deflate filter if necessary.

methods.name: removeDeflateFilter
methods.description: Removes the deflate filter from the stream if it exists.

methods.name: addDeflateFilter
methods.description: Adds a deflate stream filter to the stream with specified options.
